storySection.title: A Packaging Story of Love & Innovation
paragraphs: Valentine’s season is one of the most competitive times for brands to win hearts and stand out. KitKat India wanted to ‘own’ the season with something innovative that tied seamlessly into its iconic brand line: ‘Have a Break, Have a KitKat.’ The challenge was to connect love with the break narrative in a fresh, memorable way.
This was not just about creating a wrapper — it was about crafting a brand packaging design that would become a cultural moment.

challenge.title: Why PRAKRIA?
challenge.description: KitKat required more than standard packaging designers; they needed a design agency that could think strategically, creatively, and technologically. The brief required speed, uniqueness, and impeccable execution. With a proven record of packaging design excellence, Prakria was selected to lead this high-profile campaign.
list: Strategic and creative packaging design thinking
Technological integration for customization and innovation
Fast-paced delivery with high creative standards
Packaging design that doubles as brand storytelling

startageySection.title: Our Solution — The 'Love Break' Concept
startageySection.description: One concept emerged immediately in brainstorming: 'Love Break.' Love is emotional, personal, and individualized — much like each relationship. So what if the package itself told that story of individuality? Using HP Mosaic and Collage Digital Printing technology, we created thousands of unique packs, each with its own design, color palette, and message.

list.title: Conceptual Innovation
list.description: The 'Love Break' idea positioned KitKat as more than a snack — it became a symbol of affection and connection.

list.title: Mass Personalization
list.description: Every KitKat pack had a unique design, featuring millennial slang, fun motifs, and vibrant tones appealing to a youthful audience.

list.title: Technology Meets Emotion
list.description: Through HP Mosaic and Collage printing, digital technology was used to translate individuality into tangible design.

executionSection.title: Creative Execution
executionSection.description: Every layer of design was intentional — from concept to retail impact — ensuring KitKat’s Valentine campaign stood out as an emotional and visual experience.

list.title: Product Packaging Design
list.description: Each wrapper was crafted to feel fresh and collectible, using bold typography and millennial-inspired symbols.

list.title: Brand Packaging Design
list.description: Every element tied back to KitKat’s essence of sharing breaks, now reimagined around sharing love.

list.title: Package Logo Design & Labelling
list.description: The familiar KitKat identity remained central, surrounded by playful, love-centric graphics.

list.title: Retail Packaging Design
list.description: Packs were optimized for shelf impact — instantly recognizable and attractive during the Valentine’s rush.

list.title: Luxury Packaging Design Touch
list.description: Unique packs elevated KitKat from a simple treat to a thoughtful, gift-ready product.

list.title: Every Pack Became a Limited Edition
list.description: No two packs were alike — each one represented an individual love story.

resultSection.title: Impact
resultSection.description: The 'Love Break' campaign wasn’t just a packaging initiative — it became a nationwide phenomenon that inspired gifting and sharing.

list.text: Thousands of unique packs were rolled out across India, with no two designs alike.
Social media buzz skyrocketed as users shared photos of their personalized KitKat wrappers.
Reinforced KitKat’s youthful and emotional connection through shareable, visually rich design.
Retailers reported high shelf movement, making it one of the most successful Valentine’s pushes.

storySection.title: A Sophisticated Design Challenge
paragraphs: When 100 Pipers came to us, the challenge was daring: produce a Limited Edition pack that would break through the noise, communicate sophistication, and make an impact. They needed something sleek, elegant, and visually distinctive — packaging that would transform the brand in a crowded shelf environment.
This wasn’t simply about building another wrapper — it was about creating a packaging design for a brand that would be seen as a work of art.

challenge.title: Why PRAKRIA?
challenge.description: This project demanded creative freedom balanced with strategic discipline. The visual approach needed to push boundaries while staying true to brand identity and taste. That’s where Prakria shines — as a packaging design agency that blends artistic risk-taking with structural rigor.
list: Creative freedom guided by strategic discipline
Visual storytelling while respecting brand identity
Expertise in custom packaging and structural design
Delivering artistry balanced with commercial functionality

startageySection.title: Our Solution — The Deconstructivist Art Pack
startageySection.description: We wanted the pack itself to become an experience. So, we adopted a post-modern Deconstructivist art style — deconstructing the iconic Piper figure and reconstructing it across the bottle series. Each bottle became a fragment of a larger visual story. When placed side-by-side, the design completed itself.

list.title: Innovative Packaging Design
list.description: The fragmented visual across bottles created intrigue — the full image was revealed only in collective display.

list.title: Retail Packaging Design Flair
list.description: On shelves, the range enticed consumers to collect, compare, and engage visually.

list.title: Custom Packaging Design Artistry
list.description: Each bottle maintained visual individuality while contributing to the larger artistic composition.

list.title: Brand Packaging Consistency
list.description: Despite the fragmentation, the Piper motif and brand DNA remained recognizable and intact.

executionSection.title: Creative & Technical Execution
executionSection.description: Every design element was engineered for precision, harmony, and aesthetic delight. From label structure to final print, each step reinforced the art-led philosophy.

list.title: Package Label Design & Graphic Layout
list.description: Each label fragment was structured so lines, shapes, and negatives aligned seamlessly across bottles.

list.title: Structural Design Coordination
list.description: Collaborated with bottling partners to align deconstructed art accurately on cylindrical surfaces.

list.title: Premium Finish & Print Execution
list.description: High-contrast colors, crisp lines, and premium print finishes gave the pack its luxury feel.

list.title: Range Strategy
list.description: The full visual narrative emerged only when the complete range was displayed side-by-side, boosting collectability and shelf storytelling.

resultSection.title: Impact & Reception
resultSection.description: The Limited Edition 100 Pipers packaging became a retail standout — a fine balance of design, art, and brand storytelling.

list.text: High shelf visibility — the fragmented art triggered second glances and buzz.
Increased brand prestige — the packaging elevated the product perception.
Social and visual appeal — consumers shared and discussed the art-inspired bottles.
Positive client feedback — the brand acknowledged that we didn’t just meet expectations, we exceeded them.

storySection.title: A Festive Story That Illuminated Hearts
paragraphs: Imagine seeing a box of chocolates in a Canadian store during Diwali that immediately brings back memories of home — its warmth, glow, and spirit. With its Quality Street line, Nestlé aimed to provide precisely that for Indians residing overseas. When they came to PRAKRIA TECH, the task was clear: create a festive package that carried emotions as much as chocolates — a pack that could illuminate hearts like a Diya lights up homes.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.description: For Indians living abroad, Diwali is more than a festival — it’s a feeling of home. Nestlé wanted to capture that emotion for its Quality Street range in Canada, turning a box of chocolates into something that would spark nostalgia, pride, and joy. The brief to us at Prakria was exciting and demanding: design a packaging concept that honored tradition but felt modern, premium, and gift-worthy — something people would treasure even after the last chocolate was gone.
list: Translate cultural emotion into global design appeal
Create a premium festive package that felt collectible
Balance Indian symbolism with modern aesthetics
Design packaging that consumers would proudly display

startageySection.title: Why They Chose Us
startageySection.description: Quality Street needed more than packaging designers — they needed storytellers. They sought a design company that could blend creativity, cultural insight, and emotional storytelling. With our expertise in brand packaging design, custom packaging, and innovative design execution, Prakria was entrusted to bring Diwali to life through packaging that would glow both visually and emotionally.

list.title: Strategic Storytelling Approach
list.description: Merged cultural symbolism with modern luxury packaging to evoke nostalgia and pride.

list.title: Design That Connects
list.description: Focused on emotional resonance and shelf standout through light, color, and form.

list.title: Holistic Festive Experience
list.description: Created a collectible pack that doubled as décor — more than just packaging.

executionSection.title: Our Idea: A Box That Lights Up the Festival
executionSection.description: We were inspired by the idea of the Diya — glowing softly in every Indian home. What if the box itself could become that symbol of light? We reshaped the familiar Quality Street pack into a Diya silhouette — elegant yet practical — connecting instantly with the spirit of Diwali. Every element was designed with intention and meaning.

list.title: The folds and angles
list.description: The box structure mirrored the frame of a Diya, symbolizing warmth and togetherness.

list.title: Colors & Finishes
list.description: The colors and metallic finishes felt celebratory — rich purples, golds, and warm hues, not cliché.

list.title: Label Design
list.description: Balanced Nestlé’s branding with intricate traditional motifs that carried festive meaning.

list.title: Inside Layout
list.description: The chocolates were arranged like jewels — creating a glowing, gift-like experience upon opening.

resultSection.title: The Impact
resultSection.description: The response was overwhelming. For the Indian diaspora in Canada, the pack became more than a treat — it was a reminder of home. Families displayed it proudly during celebrations, while shoppers picked it up not just for chocolates but for its design. Retailers reported rapid sell-outs, and the campaign created buzz across communities. The design extended the product’s life well beyond the holiday, strengthening Quality Street’s visibility and emotional connection.

list.text: High emotional resonance among the Indian diaspora community.
Retailers saw increased off-shelf pickup and social media buzz.
The pack was often repurposed as décor — extending product value.
Quality Street’s brand perception elevated from festive treat to heartfelt gift.

whySection.title: Why This Project Matters
whySection.description: This project is a reminder of how powerful packaging design can be when rooted in culture and emotion. The Quality Street Diwali pack succeeded because it married tradition with innovation.

list.text: It went beyond just holding chocolates — it created an emotional experience.
Showed how innovative packaging can drive cultural relevance and brand love.

Blended luxury packaging with heartfelt storytelling — making it a keepsake.

storySection.title: The Concept — A Break at Your Desk
paragraphs: As work moved out of offices and into homes, our desks became all-day destinations. With back-to-back calls and endless to-do lists, everyone was in need of little pick-me-ups to keep the day going. Perfetti noticed this shift and wondered — what if we could give people a little joy, right at their desks?

That’s how the concept of the Workdesk Pack came to life — a convenient combination of favorite treats, designed especially for home-office life. To bring this idea to reality, Perfetti partnered with Prakria to create a pack that was practical, delightful, and perfectly timed for the new normal.

challenge.title: Why Us
challenge.description: This project wasn’t about simply placing candies in a box. Perfetti needed a team that could design something quick, clever, and full of personality. At Prakria, we blend product packaging design expertise with strategy and imagination. From bespoke packaging concepts to clever design execution, we know how to make brands sparkle. Perfetti trusted us because we’re not just designers — we’re storytellers who craft packaging that connects with people’s everyday lives.
list: Quick turnaround with creative precision
Packaging that balances fun with functionality
Design that fits perfectly into daily routines
A concept that’s instantly relatable and uplifting

startageySection.description: We asked ourselves: if a pack is going to sit on someone’s desk all day, what should it feel like? The answer — bright enough to lift moods, compact enough to fit anywhere, and fun enough to make people smile.

storySection.title: The Story — Turning Everyday Moments into Escapes
paragraphs: Imagine a simple daily routine that suddenly feels like a vacation: opening a box that takes you to the lavender fields of France or the calm Mediterranean coastlines. Palmolive approached PRAKRIA TECH with a vision to make that happen — to turn a regular shower into a sensory retreat.

Our mission was clear: design packaging that carried feelings of wanderlust, luxury, and tranquility. We set out to create the 'European Bathing Treasures' pack — an experience that wasn’t just about products, but about emotion and escape.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.description: Palmolive, known globally for care products, wanted to go beyond the ordinary. They didn’t just want packaging — they wanted an experience. The brief was to make every unboxing moment feel like a mini holiday, blending visual indulgence with emotional resonance. The challenge was to make people pause, breathe, and experience calm in their everyday lives.
list: Create packaging that communicates calm, luxury, and escape.
Blend European aesthetics with modern simplicity.
Ensure design consistency across product formats.
Make the box feel like a gift, not just packaging.

startageySection.title: Our Idea — “European Bathing Treasures”
startageySection.description: We asked ourselves: what makes a bath feel like a ritual? Scents, textures, and visuals that take you elsewhere. That’s how 'European Bathing Treasures' was born — a kit inspired by Europe’s spa traditions, designed to evoke serenity and luxury through every detail.

list.title: Soft Color Palette
list.description: Used hues inspired by lavender fields and Mediterranean seasides to create a sense of calm and sophistication.

list.title: Elegant Typography
list.description: Refined, balanced fonts that felt premium yet approachable — evoking timeless European design cues.

list.title: Thoughtful Structure
list.description: The kit unfolded gracefully, turning unboxing into a moment of mindfulness and beauty.

executionSection.title: How We Brought It to Life
executionSection.description: We transformed Palmolive’s idea into a tangible journey — a packaging design that felt luxurious yet comforting, indulgent yet accessible.

list.title: Research & Inspiration
list.description: We drew from spa rituals, European art, and natural textures to craft moodboards reflecting calmness and luxury.

list.title: Concept Development
list.description: Explored structural and visual possibilities — from how the box opens to how the bottles rest inside.

list.title: Design & Structure
list.description: Created a sturdy, elegant, and gift-ready box where graphics and structure worked in harmony.

list.title: Finishing Touches
list.description: Used soft-touch coating, subtle foil details, and premium materials for a refined, tactile experience.

resultSection.title: The Impact
resultSection.description: The final design became more than packaging — it became an experience of European elegance at home. Retailers and customers alike admired its sophistication and giftability.

list.text: Created strong shelf appeal and brand differentiation through emotional design.
Strengthened Palmolive’s identity as a premium yet approachable care brand.
Elevated the unboxing experience to evoke calm, relaxation, and indulgence.
Transformed everyday personal care into a sensory journey, beyond routine.

whySection.title: Why This Project Matters
whySection.description: The Palmolive European Treasures project shows how packaging can be more than functional — it can be transformative. By blending storytelling, emotion, and design, we turned a shower kit into a sensory escape.

list.text: It turned packaging into a multisensory experience, not just a container.
It showcased how subtle design choices — color, texture, typography — can convey premium appeal.
It reinforced our belief that packaging is storytelling — each detail should evoke emotion and meaning.
